name: Kuromiya Reika
source:
[b]Flawless Student Council President[/b]

Silverseal Private Academy student council president. 

She excels at every aspect, boasting an outstanding academic performance with top grades for every subject in her year. The only subject that she can never ace is Math, where she is beaten by our protagonist [url=https://vndb.org/c139083]Yuuma[/url].

She is confident and treats everyone equally. This has won her the trust of not only all of the students, but the entire school faculty as well.

Contrary to her appearance, she loves cute rabbit dolls and has never told anyone.

[i]"Everyone makes mistakes, even God let you be born."[/i]
